page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 2 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, resulting in 2 vCPUs. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware. Advanced CPU instruction sets, such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-assisted cryptography (AES, SHA), are not supported on this instance profile. The lack of local storage requires the attachment of external block storage for operating system and application data.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.s2.xlarge offers a balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio suitable for entry-to-mid-tier workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable instances. This profile is appropriate for general-purpose workloads such as lightweight web serving, small application servers, development environments, and basic microservices that do not require specialized hardware acceleration.
